decision_rule: Qualify three individual model-free HSA/host/profiler witness points only when three distinct own-process kernels on one MI210 and queue have host bracketing, ordered host samples, exact integer offsets with at most 1ms uncertainty, six-second bounded spacing and all four missing/duplicate/PID/time mutations rejected. Stop on failed identity, custody, cleanup, STOP or deadline. This does not prove continuous drift, interpolation, native target alignment or attribution.
notes: Standalone model-free qualification, not the target profile; source and profiler are sealed. Does not establish process-bound calibration of the future profiled child.
